doc_title: Quarrendon Vale Infrastructure Secondaries Fund II, L.P. Summary of Principal Terms and Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership
doc_type: LPA with Summary of Principal Terms
notes: The document opens with a Summary of Principal Terms table whose GP Commitment (1.0%) and term extensions (three, each at the General Partner's discretion) conflict with the LPA body (2%; two extensions, the second requiring Advisory Committee consent), and both the Summary preamble and Section 15.1 state that the LPA controls. A reader that stops at the table gets both wrong. The redemption group, high-water mark and prime broker are expressly disclaimed, while nearby distractors (10 Business Day drawdown notice, 45-day transfer notice, 10-day required withdrawal notice, a 6% late-closing rate, a $5,000,000 discretionary floor and a bank acting as lender and hedging counterparty) invite substantive answers.

traps.gp_commitment: The Summary table says the General Partner and its Affiliates commit 1.0% of total Capital Commitments, but Section 3.2 of the LPA requires not less than 2%, and the precedence clause makes the LPA value correct.
traps.fund_term: The Summary table allows three one-year extensions each at the General Partner's discretion, but Section 2.3 permits only two (the second with Advisory Committee consent) and caps the term at the fourteenth anniversary of the Final Closing Date; the LPA controls.
traps.lockup_period: Section 10.1 expressly states there is no lock-up period because Limited Partners have no withdrawal or redemption right; any period given is a hallucination.
traps.redemption_frequency: The Partnership is closed-end with no redemption dates (Section 10.1); quarterly distribution timing in Section 6.1 is not a redemption frequency.
traps.redemption_notice_days: Section 10.1 states there is no redemption notice requirement; the 10 Business Day drawdown notice, the 45-day transfer notice and the 10-day required-withdrawal notice are not redemption notice periods.
traps.gate_provision: Section 10.1 expressly states there is no gate; the 2% annual transfer limit in Section 11.2 is a publicly traded partnership safe harbor, not a gate.
traps.prime_broker: Section 13.4 states the Partnership does not engage a prime broker; Ostrander Keel Bank, N.A. is only the lender and currency hedging counterparty.
traps.high_water_mark: Section 6.4 states that no high water mark, loss carryforward or similar mechanism applies to the Carried Interest; the clawback is the only adjustment, so the correct answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
